# ExtendedFirework

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** ExtendedFirework

## What it does

ExtendedFirework boosts the speed you gain while flying with an elytra and a firework rocket. Normally a firework rocket pushes you forward at a fixed rate; this module multiplies that push so each rocket carries you noticeably faster and farther.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/movement/extendedfirework). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
